---
title: "Capturing cropping-system complexities at scale: full analysis"
subtitle: "SHMI calibration and corn-yield analyses (Moore & Manter)"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    df_print: paged
params:
  run_napeshm_rebuild: false   # A0  rebuild NAPESHM_rebuilt.xlsx from the raw NAPESHM files
  run_calibration: false       # A1-A8 SEM, SHMI calibration, SHAPE (hours; frozen for the paper)
  run_conversion: false        # B0  rebuild the AgCROS workbooks even if present (python; they are built anyway when missing)
  run_yield: false             # B1-B5, B7-B8 yield analyses and figures
  run_n_scenarios: true        # B5b N-accounting sensitivity: 20 legume x manure scenarios (30-60 min)
  run_weights: true            # B6  yield results under three SHMI weight sets (slow)
  run_site_sensitivity: true   # B9  site-combination runs (7 sites, + INWLTPAC, + MNMOFS, refinements)
  in_session: false            # TRUE: run every step in this R session instead of a fresh one (debugging; avoids callr crashes)
  python: ""                   # python executable; "" = python3, else python, on the PATH
  agcros_tables: "Inputs/agcros/extracted_tables"
  B_boot: 2000                 # calibration: site-bootstrap draws
  R_outer: 50                  # calibration: repeats of nested cross-validation
  B_sens: 1000                 # calibration: bootstrap draws, sensitivity runs
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "")
ROOT <- here::here()
# params exists only when knitting; when the chunks are run one by one in the console,
# read the defaults from this file's YAML header (edit them there)
if (!exists("params")) params <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(file.path(ROOT, "run_all.Rmd"))$params
setwd(ROOT)
source(here::here("R", "run_helpers.R"))
options(shmi.in_session = isTRUE(params$in_session))
start_log(ROOT)
```

This document reruns every analysis in the paper, in order. Each script runs in a
fresh R session (`callr`), so objects left by one step cannot affect the next. The
log of each step is in `Outputs/logs/<run time>/`. The parameters in the header choose
which parts run. Knit with **Knit with Parameters** in RStudio, or:

```r
rmarkdown::render("run_all.Rmd", params = list(run_calibration = TRUE))
```

Inputs that cannot be shipped with the code are listed in `Inputs/README.md`; the
check below reports any that are missing for the parts selected.

# Setup

```{r check, results = "asis"}
# Python builds the AgCROS workbooks, soil C and the treatment table. It is needed only
# when one of those files is missing (or rebuilding is asked for); otherwise the existing
# files are used and the run is R only.
PY <- tryCatch(find_python(params$python), error = function(e) NA_character_)
if (!is.na(PY) && !isTRUE(tryCatch({ check_python(PY); TRUE }, error = function(e) FALSE))) PY <- NA_character_
cat("Python:", if (is.na(PY)) "not available (R-only run)" else PY, "\n")
py_need <- python_needed(params)
if (is.na(PY) && length(py_need))
  stop("Python is needed to build: ", paste(py_need, collapse = "; "),
       ". Install python with pandas, openpyxl and numpy, or put those files in place (see Inputs/README.md).")
cat("SHMI package:", as.character(utils::packageVersion("SHMI")), "\n")
need <- required_inputs(params)
show_inputs(need)
if (any(!need$present & need$required)) stop("Required inputs are missing (above). See Inputs/README.md.")
```

# Part A: SHMI calibration

The calibration fixed the SHMI weights used everywhere else
(Cover 0.687, Diversity 0.150, Inverse disturbance 0.163, growing-season share 0.76,
organic amendment bonus). It takes several hours and is off by default
(`run_calibration`); its outputs are only needed by the yield analyses through the
SHAPE file in step A7 (a copy of which is in `data/`).

```{r A0-napeshm}
if (params$run_napeshm_rebuild) {
  # A0. NAPESHM management records -> SHMI workbook (rules: python/napeshm_rebuild/conversion_rules.md)
  run_py(PY, c("python/napeshm_rebuild/convert.py", "Inputs/napeshm_raw", "Outputs/napeshm_converted.json"),
         "A0_napeshm_convert")
  run_py(PY, c("python/napeshm_rebuild/write_wb.py", "Inputs/napeshm_raw/NAPESHM_test.xlsx",
               "Outputs/napeshm_converted.json", "Outputs/NAPESHM_rebuilt.xlsx"), "A0_napeshm_write")
  cat("Compare Outputs/NAPESHM_rebuilt.xlsx with Inputs/NAPESHM_rebuilt.xlsx (the workbook used, after QC).\n")
} else cat("Skipped: run_napeshm_rebuild is FALSE\n")
```

```{r A1-sem}
if (params$run_calibration) {
  CAL_OPTS <- list(shmi.B_boot = params$B_boot, shmi.R_outer = params$R_outer, shmi.B_sens = params$B_sens)
  # A1. soils (SHAPE soil groups), SEM data, measured soil health, climate normals
  if (file.exists(Sys.getenv("GSSURGO_GPKG", "Inputs/gSSURGO_CONUS.gpkg"))) {
    run_r("Get_site_ssurgo.R")
  } else message("gSSURGO not found: using Outputs/site_soils_ssurgo.csv if present (see Inputs/README.md)")
  run_r("Prepare_SEM.R")
  run_r("SH_SEM_refinement_clean.R")
  if (!file.exists("Outputs/site_climate_monthly.rds")) run_r("Get_site_climate.R")
} else cat("Skipped: run_calibration is FALSE\n")
```

```{r A2-calibration}
if (params$run_calibration) {
  # A2. weight structure, calibration scenarios, Mexico projection, four-pillar calibration
  for (s in c("SHMI_weight_tests.R", "Run_calibration_scenarios.R", "Project_SH.R",
              "SHMI_calibration_final.R", "Compare_v110_v120.R", "Summarize_results.R"))
    run_r(s, opts = CAL_OPTS)
  # A3. final calibration (three pillars + amendment bonus) and its figures (Fig. 1-2, Table 10b)
  run_r("SHMI_calibration_plus.R", opts = CAL_OPTS)
  run_r("Fig5_Fig6_fit_plus.R")
  # A4. SHMI against its own components
  run_r("SHMI_benchmark.R", opts = CAL_OPTS)
  # A5. weights fitted between sites, to all variation and within sites (ED Fig. 7)
  run_r("Run_within_calibration_scenarios.R", opts = CAL_OPTS)
  run_r("ED_Fig7_weights_by_comparison.R")
} else cat("Skipped: run_calibration is FALSE\n")
```

```{r A6-shape}
if (params$run_calibration) {
  # A6. SHAPE: input file for the SHAPE app; its output (batch_Combined_scores.csv) is
  # produced outside R and read back from Inputs/SHAPE/
  run_r("Prepare_SHAPE.R")
  dir.create("Outputs/SHAPE", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  if (file.exists("Inputs/SHAPE/batch_Combined_scores.csv")) {
    file.copy("Inputs/SHAPE/batch_Combined_scores.csv", "Outputs/SHAPE/batch_Combined_scores.csv", overwrite = TRUE)
    run_r("Merge_SHAPE_SHMI.R")
    run_r("SHMI_SHAPE_age.R")
  } else message("Run Outputs/SHAPE/SHAPE_multi_indicator_input.csv through the SHAPE app and put ",
                 "batch_Combined_scores.csv in Inputs/SHAPE/, then rerun this chunk.")
  # A7-A8. WorldClim vs Daymet season check; appendix tables
  run_r("Check_climate_source.R")
  run_r("Export_appendix_tables.R")
} else cat("Skipped: run_calibration is FALSE\n")
```

# Part B: corn yield

## B0. Workbooks and soil data

The seven AgCROS experiments are converted from the AgCROS table export by
`agcros2shmi.py` (rules in `python/agcros2shmi/README.md`): NECCIRR's fertilizer and
manure come from a supplement, and two NEMLTCRS record errors are corrected. The
Ohio and Wisconsin workbooks were built by hand from DRIVES and are inputs.

```{r B0-conversion}
TEMPLATE <- system.file("extdata", "SHMI_template.xlsx", package = "SHMI")
if (!nzchar(TEMPLATE)) stop("SHMI_template.xlsx not found in the installed SHMI package (extdata)")
WB <- "Inputs/yield_workbooks"
dir.create(WB, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
conv <- function(sites, extra = character(), label) {
  run_py(PY, c("python/agcros2shmi/agcros2shmi.py", params$agcros_tables, sites,
               "--template", TEMPLATE, "--out", WB, extra), label)
}
if (conv_needed(params)) {
  conv(c("NELITCSE", "NEMLTCRS", "NEMEIRR", "NECCIRR"),
       c("--supplement", "python/agcros2shmi/supplements/NECCIRR_amendments.csv",
         "--corrections", "python/agcros2shmi/corrections/NEMLTCRS_corrections.csv"), "B0_convert_nebraska")
  conv(c("INWLACRE", "IAAM7071", "PAUP"), label = "B0_convert_added")
} else cat("AgCROS workbooks present; not rebuilt (set run_conversion = TRUE to rebuild)\n")
if (params$run_site_sensitivity && conv_needed(params, c("INWLTPAC", "MNMOFS")))
  conv(c("INWLTPAC", "MNMOFS"), label = "B0_convert_screened")
```

```{r B0-soil}
# soil C by plot and layer (AgCROS) and NAPESHM soil health (for the mediation test)
dir.create("Outputs/yield", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
if (conv_needed(params) || !file.exists("Outputs/yield/soil_c.csv"))
  run_py(PY, c("python/build_soil_c.py", params$agcros_tables, "Outputs/yield"), "B0_soil_c")
if (!file.exists("Outputs/SHAPE/SHAPE_by_unit_with_SHMI.csv")) {   # Part A not run: shipped copy
  dir.create("Outputs/SHAPE", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  file.copy("data/SHAPE_by_unit_with_SHMI.csv", "Outputs/SHAPE/SHAPE_by_unit_with_SHMI.csv")
}
run_r("build_napeshm_crosswalk.R")
```

## B1-B5. Main yield analyses

```{r B1-B5}
if (params$run_yield) {
  run_r("Get_SPEI.R")                    # B1 growing-season SPEI for every site-year
  run_r("SHMI_yield_main.R")             # B2 within-site SHMI slope, SHMI x N, SHMI x age, forest plot
  run_r("SHMI_yield_stability.R")        # B3 year conditions, worst years, drought
  run_r("SHMI_N_equivalent.R")           # B4 SHMI in fertilizer-N units
  run_r("SHMI_soil_mediation.R")         # B5 soil-health mediation
} else cat("Skipped: run_yield is FALSE\n")
```

## B5b. Nitrogen accounting

Methods (Nitrogen) reports the range of the SHMI slope over 20 legume-credit ×
manure-availability assumptions and which accounting fits best.

```{r B5b}
# Self-contained: reloads sections 1-3 of SHMI_yield_main.R (site runs from the cache),
# so it can run without run_yield.
if (isTRUE(params$run_n_scenarios)) {
  run_r("SHMI_N_scenarios.R")
} else cat("Skipped: run_n_scenarios is FALSE\n")
```

## B6. SHMI weight sets

```{r B6}
if (params$run_weights) {
  run_r("SHMI_yield_weights_sensitivity.R")
} else cat("Skipped: run_weights is FALSE\n")
```

## B7-B8. Figures and treatment table

```{r B7-B8}
if (params$run_yield) {
  run_r("Assemble_manuscript_figures.R")
  if (!is.na(PY)) run_py(PY, c("python/build_study_treatments.py", "--wb-dir", "Inputs/yield_workbooks",
               "--units-dir", "Inputs/yield_workbooks", "--old", "data/SHMI_study_treatments_descriptions.xlsx",
               "--out", "Outputs/SHMI_study_treatments.xlsx"), "B8_study_treatments") else
    cat("No python: Supplementary treatment table (B8) not rebuilt\n")
} else cat("Skipped: run_yield is FALSE\n")
```

## B9. Site combinations

```{r B9}
if (params$run_site_sensitivity) {
  runs <- list(
    sites7       = list(INCLUDE_AGCROS_OVERRIDE = FALSE),
    # INWLTPAC and MNMOFS get a linear N term, like every site, but no quadratic or SHMI x N
    plus_INWLTPAC = list(AGCROS_SITES_OVERRIDE = c("INWLACRE", "IAAM7071", "PAUP", "INWLTPAC")),
    plus_MNMOFS   = list(AGCROS_SITES_OVERRIDE = c("INWLACRE", "IAAM7071", "PAUP", "MNMOFS")),
    refine        = list(AGCROS_REFINE_OVERRIDE = TRUE),
    # SHMI x N from the three N-rate sites only (without INWLACRE's two rates)
    NxSHMI_3sites = list(N_INTERACT_SITES_OVERRIDE = c("NEMLTCRS", "NECCIRR", "WICST_ARS")))
  run_r("Get_SPEI.R", vars = list(AGCROS_SITES_OVERRIDE = c("INWLACRE", "IAAM7071", "PAUP", "INWLTPAC", "MNMOFS")),
        label = "B9_spei")
  for (nm in names(runs))
    run_r("SHMI_yield_main.R", vars = c(runs[[nm]], OUT_OVERRIDE = file.path("Outputs", paste0("yield_main_", nm))),
          label = paste0("B9_", nm))
} else cat("Skipped: run_site_sensitivity is FALSE\n")
```

MAIN <- "Outputs/yield_main_default_total_agcros"

  show_csv(file.path(MAIN, "N_equivalent.csv"), "SHMI in fertilizer-N units")
